routes.name: Visa-free entry with a valid Schengen, UK, EU or US visa or residence permit
routes.summary: If you hold a valid Schengen, UK, EU member state or US visa or residence permit, you can enter Serbia without a Serbian visa. Serbia also has a separate visa-free list by nationality that is not summarized here.

other: Applies to any national passport except emergency and international-convention travel documents.
Visa-free list by nationality not read on the official pages, check the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

routes.name: Visa C (short stay)
routes.summary: Short-stay visa for tourism, business or other travel, up to 90 days in any 180 days. Apply at a Serbian embassy or consulate, or online at welcometoserbia.gov.rs.

other: Only for nationalities that need a visa.
Passport valid 90 days past departure with two blank pages, issued in the last 10 years.
Travel medical insurance required.

steps: Create an account on eid.gov.rs if applying online.
Apply online at welcometoserbia.gov.rs or in person at a Serbian mission.
Submit documents and pay the fee.
documents: Proof of purpose of stay and invitation or proof of travel payment
Proof of accommodation, funds and ties to home country
routes.processing: Not stated on the page. Since 23 April 2025 some approvals are issued electronically depending on nationality.

routes.name: Visa D (long stay)
routes.summary: Long-stay visa for 90 to 180 days, for people planning to apply for temporary residence (work, study, family reunification). Apply at a Serbian mission or online.

other: Only for nationalities that need a visa.
Intended for people who will apply for temporary residence.

routes.name: Transit through Serbia
routes.summary: To transit, you need an entry visa for the next country after Serbia. If that country is visa-free for you, you must show documents explaining the visit there. Airside transit rules were not on the page.

other: Airside transit visa rules not confirmed.

routes.name: Temporary residence and work (Single Permit)
routes.summary: One online Single Permit covers residence and work. It covers employment, self-employment, intra-company transfers, independent professionals, trainees, volunteers and more.

other: Employment needs a labor market test ID number and an employment contract.
Self-employment needs a registered business where you are founder or owner.
Intra-corporate transfer needs proof the Serbian employer is a subsidiary.
Independent professionals need a diploma and at least 3 years of experience.

stay.note: Apply to extend at least 3 months before expiry.

documents: Passport valid 3+ months beyond the permit
Proof of subsistence and health insurance

routes.name: Temporary residence for study
routes.summary: Temporary residence for school, higher education, Serbian language courses and student or pupil exchanges. Higher education needs enrollment confirmation from an accredited institution.

other: Enrollment confirmation with study duration.
Minors need a parental affidavit and an adult guarantor.
Proof of subsistence and health insurance.

routes.name: Temporary residence for family reunification
routes.summary: Residence for spouses, common-law partners and children of Serbian citizens or foreign residents. After four years you can apply for independent residence.

other: Marriage certificate, proof of a common-law union and shared address, or the child's birth certificate.
Proof of subsistence and health insurance when the sponsor is not on an employment permit.

routes.name: Temporary residence for investors in a registered company
routes.summary: First permit is for 6 months. You show a bank certificate of at least EUR 50,000 invested in a registered company. To extend, show at least EUR 5,000 in cash capital contributed.

routes.name: Temporary residence for innovative company founders
routes.summary: One-year residence for founders of innovative companies, confirmed by a Science and Technology Park. Extension needs employing Serbian citizens, RSD 1,000,000 income, or Park confirmation of active innovation.

other: Document from a Science and Technology Park confirming innovative activity.

routes.name: Temporary residence for people of Serbian origin
routes.summary: One-year residence if you can prove Serbian ancestry with a public document or baptism record. Extension needs employment, a company, real estate, income or pension.

other: Public document or baptism record proving Serbian ancestry.

routes.name: Temporary residence for property owners, medical treatment and religious service
routes.summary: Residence is possible on grounds like owning real estate (with proof of subsistence and health insurance), medical treatment, religious service and social care. Durations and amounts were not listed.

other: Real estate ownership needs a land register extract plus subsistence and health insurance proof.
No retirement or passive income route is named on the page.

routes.name: Permanent residence
routes.summary: Apply after 3 years of continuous temporary residence or asylum. Absences can total up to 10 months, or one absence up to 6 months. Apply in person.

other: Proof of subsistence at least the Serbian minimum salary.
Health insurance and registered address.
No language requirement stated on the page.
Special cases skip the 3 years: minors with a Serbian or permanent resident parent, people of Serbian origin.

steps: Apply up to 60 days before the 3 years end, and before the temporary permit expires.
Submit in person with notarized statements and certified translations.

routes.name: Citizenship by admission (naturalization)
routes.summary: Adults with 3 years of uninterrupted registered permanent residence can apply, with a signed statement that Serbia is their country. Giving up your old citizenship is not required.

other: 3 years of uninterrupted registered permanent residence.
Language requirement not stated on the page.

citizenship.note: Check whether your other country allows dual citizenship.

routes.name: Citizenship through marriage
routes.summary: A foreigner married 3 years to a Serbian national, with permanent residence, can apply with a signed statement that Serbia is their country.

other: Married at least 3 years to a Serbian citizen.
Granted permanent residence.

routes.name: Citizenship by descent or Serbian origin
routes.summary: Children of Serbian nationals are citizens by origin. Emigrants and their descendants, and members of the Serbian people, can apply by admission without living in Serbia. Number of generations was not stated.

other: Parent(s) Serbian national at birth for citizenship by origin.
Descendants and Serbian people apply with a signed statement that Serbia is their country.
Generation limit not stated.
